[ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p41#2/r1] ABDURRAZZAQ, d. 211 · مجاهد | reports | Mujahid says the earth was created before the heaven; smoke rose from it, after which God formed seven heavens, one above another, and seven earths, one below another.

[AKHFASH:v1p61/r3] AKHFASH, d. 215 · يونس | reports | Yunus says السماء in 65:12 is masculine, as a feminine noun may take masculine agreement; he cites poetry with أبقل and أودى. | mentions 65:12
[AKHFASH:v1p61/r4] AKHFASH, d. 215 · author | holds | السماء can also refer to a whole class, as in saying the sheep and camel perished to mean every sheep and camel; مثلهن in 2:12 means earths. | mentions 2:12
[AKHFASH:v1p61/r5] AKHFASH, d. 215 · author | holds | God's استواء here does not mean a change of place; it means His action turned toward the heaven, like a caliph whose governing action shifts regions.
[IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p45/r1] IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB, d. 276 · author | holds | Istawā ilā means that God turned or directed Himself toward the heaven.

[IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p45/r3] IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB, d. 276 · author | holds | The pronoun in fasawwāhunna refers to the seven heavens.
[TAB-FULL:v1p451/r10] TAB-FULL, d. 310 · author | holds | The word mā functions as the relative pronoun meaning 'that which.'
[TAB-FULL:v1p451/r11] TAB-FULL, d. 310 · author | holds | God made them living humans after they were semen in their fathers' loins, will kill and raise them for reward or punishment, and provides earthly livelihoods and proofs of His oneness.

[TAB-FULL:v1p451/r5] TAB-FULL, d. 310 · author | holds | The following account of Adam shows God's honor to humanity, the consequences of disobedience for Adam and Iblis, mercy for Adam's repentance, and punishment for Iblis's pride and refusal to repent.

[TAB-FULL:v1p454#2/r1] TAB-FULL, d. 310 · بعضهم | reports | Some interpret istawā ilā as turning toward the heaven, by analogy with Arabic expressions for turning toward or against someone.

[TAB-FULL:v1p457/r9] TAB-FULL, d. 310 · author | holds | In Arabic, taswiya means straightening, correcting, repairing, or preparing something.
